boundary: Fixed teaching arrays only. No vendor model, tokenizer, GPU, distributed communication or quality/speed benchmark is executed.

routing.tieBreak: Lower expert index wins equal biased scores. Display selected experts in ascending expert order.
routing.gate: Normalize original selected affinities, not biased selection scores; V3-style teaching choice. Affinities are direct inputs, no sigmoid/logit backprop.

sinkhorn.normalizationOrder: Rows, then columns; one iteration means both normalizations. No stabilizing epsilon added to positive denominators.

singlePass.boundary: Compare one transition with explicitly supplied state and coefficients; no coefficient predictor, initial-block policy or fused kernel is implemented.
